newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to decrease coffee margins August 19.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to decrease coffee margins August 19.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Monday it will decrease the margin on the September "C" coffee contract to $4,500, including a $1,500 spot charge, effective August 19.
The current margin required for September is $6,000, including a $2,000 spot charge.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be decreased by $1,000 to $3,000, the exchange said in a statement.
In addition, CSCE said straddle or arbitrage transactions involving the September contract will require a minimum of $2,500, down from the current margin of $3,000.
The margin required for all other coffee straddle or arbitrage transactions will remain at $1,000, the exchange said.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
